csv_project_name: Design for STH 170 Menomonie Road Resurfacing
csv_agency: State of Wisconsin Dept of Trans Div Of Hwys
csv_scope_of_work: The State of Wisconsin , Department of transportation , may be seeking a Consultant to provide Design for Perpetuation project to resurface approximately 8.36 miles of STH 79 from STH 170 to STH 64 in Dunn County. Design a 4 inch mill and 4 inch overlay. Additional work includes railroad crossing surface work by railroad company, culvert work (1 replacement, 2 cleaning, 1 extension), adding high friction surface treatment & widening paved shoulders around 2 horizontal curves, inlet repair, adding 2 inlets & storm sewer, spot rehabilitation of guardrail at 2 bridges, pavement markings, and curb ramp upgrades. The pavement resurfacing work will be completed under detour until lower layer is paved and under traffic using lane closures with flagging operation for remainder of work. Railroad crossing work will be done under detour. Temporary pedestrian accommodations required for curb ramp work.
